subject: Azure Private Plan — Blue River Health commercial terms & PO path
messages:
From: Elena Cortez <ecortez@blueriverhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@blueriverhealth.com
Date: 2027-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Azure Private Plan — commercial terms and PO process

Hi Jordan / Aisha,

Thanks again for walking us through the Azure Private Plan yesterday. Procurement here at Blue River Health reviewed the draft commercial terms and asked that we route a few items to legal and finance before we can issue an LOI/PO. High-level asks: 

- Confirm the final commercial rate for committed capacity (rate per vGPU / month) and the effective start date if we sign by 11/30.
- Provide a clean copy and a redline of the Master Services Agreement showing any changes to data residency, indemnity, and termination for convenience clauses.
- We need an invoice routing / billing instructions doc and the DocuSign envelope to attach to our PO. Our standard payment terms are Net 30.

I attached a one-page summary of their procurement requirements (BRH_Procurement_Reqs.pdf) for context. Please loop in legal as needed — I've copied our procurement group on this thread.

Can we get the redline + billing instructions by EOD Monday (11/16)?

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Cortez
Sr. Procurement Lead | Blue River Health

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Attaching: BRH_PO_Instructions.pdf (billing routing + invoice examples) and an initial pricing summary that reflects the committed capacity discount we discussed.

Markus (legal), can you take the below and produce a redline of our MSA focusing on the items called out (data residency, indemnity cap, termination for convenience)? If we can turn that around Monday EOD that would keep the timeline to sign before month-end.

Aisha, I put the tentative commercial numbers in the pricing sheet; we should align on final rate before redline is finalized.

Next step: call? I'm available Mon 11/16 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min alignment with procurement + legal. Elena, does that work?

Cheers,
Jordan

Date: 2027-11-16T08:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Private Plan — commercial terms and PO process

Jordan / Team — attaching the redline: BRH_Redline_v1.pdf. I focused comments on three areas: 

1) Data residency: We accepted their ask to log customer metadata in-region, but we cannot guarantee full isolation of Azure-managed backups due to our hosted control plane; added a data processing addendum section and a reasonable effort clause.
2) Indemnity / Cap: Procurement asked to remove the indemnity cap for security breaches — we offered a carve-out: unlimited liability for gross negligence and willful misconduct, capped liability for other claims at 3x the fees paid in the prior 12 months.
3) Termination for convenience: We maintained a 90-day termination for convenience but offered a pro-rated refund for pre-paid committed capacity.

Questions for procurement/finance:
- Are prepaid commitments acceptable if we provide a pro-rata refund on termination?
- Is the proposed 3x fee cap (standard for us) acceptable, or do they need a different multiple?

If the above are OK, I can convert to a clean MSA and produce final DocuSign-ready docs.

On Mon 11/16 at 10:00 AM PT I'll join the call to review redline.

-Markus

--
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: BRH_Redline_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Elena Cortez <ecortez@blueriverhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Blue River Health Procurement <procurement@blueriverhealth.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-16T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Private Plan — commercial terms and PO process

Markus — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear summary. A few quick notes after an internal review: 

- Data residency: the carve-out language is acceptable as long as the addendum requires notification and remediation assistance if backups are accessed outside the region.
- Indemnity / Cap: our legal lead is pushing for 6x fees where feasible but is willing to accept 3x if we can get stronger language around security incident response (SLA for response times and a named escalation contact).
- Termination for convenience: procurement prefers a 60-day notice; finance will accept pro-rated refunds but wants a sample invoice schedule so they can align the PO line items.

We will take the 10:00 AM PT slot for the call and will have our finance lead (Tom Ruiz) on the call to confirm invoicing. Also, we can sign DocuSign but need the envelope to include: final MSA, SOW, and the commercial exhibit with committed capacity.

Elena

--
Elena Cortez
Sr. Procurement Lead | Blue River Health

Date: 2027-11-17T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final docs and DocuSign — Blue River Health (BRH-2027-118)

Team — good call this morning. Per action items we agreed to: 

- Liability cap: final language will be 3x fees with a security incident response SLA (72-hour initial response + named escalation contact).
- Termination: we moved to 60-day termination for convenience with pro-rated refund for unused committed capacity.
- Billing: attached BRH_PO_Instructions.pdf (updated) and a sample invoice schedule that matches the SOW line items; payment terms Net 30 per request.

Attached: BRH_SOW_v2.docx (final SOW), BRH_MSA_Clean_vFinal.pdf, BRH_PO_Instructions.pdf.

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef123456 — contains the MSA, SOW, and commercial exhibit. Elena — once you confirm the billing contact and PO number we will send the DocuSign envelope and route invoicing to the address in BRH_PO_Instructions.pdf.

Next steps:
- Elena: send PO number and billing contact.
- Aisha: once PO provided, we will generate invoice and set committed capacity start date to the first day of the following month after DocuSign completes.

Thanks all — looking forward to onboarding Blue River Health.

Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Strategic Account Executive | Redwood Inference
